snippet.title: RE: Spin! Die! Repeat! - itch launch trailer!
snippet.description:
We are super exsited to launch the prototype of the game on itch! 
This is the roguelike deckbuilding game set in isekai worlds control by a slot machine. 
Reborn and test your luck! 

https://isekaiinteractive.itch.io/re-spin-die-repeat
